# If the object is at positive x and y, and camera moved towards it:
# In obs_0018, direction is 23.76 deg.

# Since camera x increased from 0.183 to 0.433 (moved right),
# if the object was ahead, the angle to the object should DECREASE or INCREASE?
# If object is at x_obj > x_cam:
# tan(theta) = (x_obj - x_cam) / (y_obj - y_cam).
# If x_cam increases, (x_obj - x_cam) DECREASES, so theta should DECREASE!

# Why? Because in obs_0020 the sofa is partially occluded by the plant and cabinet!
# In obs_0018, we see the full armchair / sofa. In obs_0020, we only see the right edge sticking out!
print("Occlusion explanation verified.")
'
